name: Fake User JSON Generator
summary: Generate mock user JSON for fixtures and API stubs — locally in your browser.
description: Create 1–100 fake users with id, username, email, name, and phone. Enable rich mode for address, company, and job title. Use a seed for reproducible fixtures, then copy the JSON array.

faqs.question: Are these real people?
faqs.answer: No. Names and emails are synthetic placeholders for development and demos only.

faqs.question: Why use a seed?
faqs.answer: A fixed seed makes the same options produce identical JSON, which helps stable tests and screenshots.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
